integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible independent finite numerical checks; finite tests are not a proof of universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Only the finite smooth lacunary Zindler approximants are classified; no convexity assertion for the fractal limit.
No classification of nonconvex embeddings or minimal embedding radius.
Possible unindexed historical exact computations remain a priority risk, including two 2022 related journal papers unavailable in full text.
title: Sharp convexity transition for lacunary Zindler approximants
